brief:
The Colonisation and Wall Resistance Commission documented 21 attacks by Israeli forces and settlers against Palestinian farmers across six governorates in a single day, Middle East Eye reported. The incidents targeted farmers engaged in agricultural work across multiple locations.

The attacks span six Palestinian governorates, indicating a widespread pattern of incidents. The commission, which tracks Israeli military operations and settler violence, routinely documents such incidents as part of its monitoring work.
dek: Palestinian farmers face 21 attacks by Israeli forces, settlers in single day, commission says The Colonisation and Wall Resistance Commission (CWRC) has documented 21 attacks by Israeli forces and settlers against Palestinian farmers across six governorates…
title: Israeli forces and settlers attack Palestinian farmers 21 times in one day
